recommended_action: Immediately revoke sessions for user rbennett@contoso.com, force a password reset, and investigate potential follow-on actions from the compromised account stemming from the successful authentication from IP 192.0.2.44.
summary: Azure AD Identity Protection detected a password spray attack involving numerous source IPs targeting multiple user accounts. Sign-in logs confirm that user rbennett@contoso.com experienced a successful authentication from IP 192.0.2.44 following failed sign-in attempts from other distributed IPs, validating the credential compromise.
